tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: Deep Navy, RGB 30 34 53. The main ground and the heading colour: covers, section dividers, hero, footer, the business card's brand side, social posts; on light grounds it sets headings and the wordmark (13.9:1 on ivory, 15.7:1 on paper). Text on it is on-dark (13.9:1) or on-dark-soft (8.2:1); the seal on it is orange (5.0:1).

tokens.name: night-2
tokens.usage: A second night step for panels and bands that sit on night. on-dark 12.3:1, on-dark-soft 7.2:1, orange 4.4:1 (large text and the seal only).

tokens.name: orange
tokens.usage: Borom Orange, RGB 229 110 63. Accents, step numbers and actions: spend it only on what must be seen first. On night: the ring and accent text (5.0:1). On paper: the ring, large text and fills (3.2:1, never body text). On ivory (2.8:1) and soft (2.7:1): only as decoration (the cropped ring, a hairline), never as text or a functional mark. Text on an orange fill is ink (5.4:1), never white (2.8:1).

tokens.name: orange-deep
tokens.usage: Pressed and hover state of orange fills, and the darker facet in seal illustrations. 4.2:1 on paper, 3.6:1 on soft: large text and graphics only.

tokens.name: rust
tokens.usage: Orange as text on light grounds (5.4:1 on paper, 4.8:1 on ivory, 4.6:1 on soft) and a small seal on soft or ivory. High severity in reports. Never on night (2.9:1).

tokens.name: soft
tokens.usage: Soft Peach, RGB 252 233 225. The secondary ground and highlight: quiet sections, callouts, highlighted rows. Text on it is ink (14.6:1) or muted (5.3:1); the seal on it is rust.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text on paper (17.2:1), sunken and soft, and on orange fills (5.4:1). The one-colour seal and lockup for single-ink print.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Hover state of dark buttons on light grounds.

tokens.name: ivory
tokens.usage: Warm Ivory, RGB 242 241 238. Text on dark grounds, and the restful light ground: guideline and slide pages, diagrams, the business card's information side. Text on it is night or ink (13.9:1 / 15.2:1), muted (5.5:1), rust (4.8:1).

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: The plain light ground: documents, reports, web UI, dense detail. Text on it is ink or night.

tokens.name: sunken
tokens.usage: Wells, image placeholders, status pills and meters on paper. Text on it is ink or muted (5.4:1).

tokens.name: on-dark
tokens.usage: Warm Ivory as text, the wordmark and the light seal on night (13.9:1) and night-2 (12.3:1).

tokens.name: on-dark-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text on night (8.2:1) and night-2 (7.2:1): captions, ledes in small sizes, meta lines.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on paper (6.3:1), ivory (5.5:1), sunken (5.4:1) and soft (5.3:1): captions, job titles, meta lines. Not on night (2.5:1).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines on paper: document header rules, table rows. Decorative only (1.3:1); never the only cue for a control's edge.

tokens.name: line-night
tokens.usage: Hairlines on night. Decorative only (1.6:1). An addition: the website has no rule on dark grounds yet.

tokens.name: good
tokens.usage: Done, paid, credited, on paper (5.3:1) and soft (4.5:1). Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Medium severity, in review, due soon, on paper (5.9:1) and soft (5.1:1). Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: bad
tokens.usage: Critical severity, errors, overdue, on paper (5.5:1) and soft (4.7:1). Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page ground for the current theme.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Wells and panels set into surface.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: A band in the opposite ground: a night band on a paper page, a paper band on a night page.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body text on surface and surface-2.

tokens.name: heading
tokens.usage: Headings and the wordmark on surface: Deep Navy on light grounds, Warm Ivory on night.

tokens.name: text-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text on surface and surface-2 (at least 5.3:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: seal
tokens.usage: The ring on surface: 3.2:1 on paper, 5.0:1 on night. A small, functional ring on soft or ivory is rust; the big cropped ring may stay orange there as decoration.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Orange as text on surface: links, eyebrow labels, inline emphasis (5.4:1 on paper, 5.0:1 on night).

tokens.name: on-orange
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an orange fill (5.4:1).

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers on surface. Decorative only.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus outline, 3px with a 3px offset (site :focus-visible). 5.4:1 on paper, 5.0:1 on night.

tokens.name: status-good
tokens.usage: Good state as text on surface. Night value 7.8:1 on night; the brand's own green is 3.0:1 there.

tokens.name: status-warn
tokens.usage: Warning state as text on surface. Night value 8.1:1 on night.

tokens.name: status-bad
tokens.usage: Critical state as text on surface. Night value 6.2:1 on night.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells, table stripes, code blocks, input fills. The light value is the website's and the CI's sunken. Text tokens pass on it (ink 14.8:1, ink-muted 5.4:1, brand-strong 4.7:1, status colours 4.6:1 or better), but line-strong control borders and unlit stars sit at 2.9:1, just under 3:1.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, menus and dialogs. In light, separate from surface with a line, not a shadow.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and control borders (3:1 against surface in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata and placeholders, on any surface.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: BoromTech Orange, the identity color. Fills only: primary buttons, active tabs, highlights, illustration blocks. Never as text on white (3.2:1).

tokens.name: brand-deep
tokens.usage: Pressed and hover state of brand fills, and the darker facet in illustrations: the CI's orange-deep. on-brand ink on it is 4.0:1, so it is a passing state or a graphic, never a resting fill behind body-size text.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand fill. Dark ink, never white: white on brand fails at 3.2:1, ink passes at 5.4:1.

tokens.name: brand-strong
tokens.usage: Orange as text: links, inline emphasis, selected labels. On the surfaces and brand-soft.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted backgrounds behind brand-strong text: selected rows, info callouts.

tokens.name: night-ink
tokens.usage: Text on a night fill.

tokens.name: night-ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text on night (8.2:1, 6.2:1 on the dark theme's night) and night-2 (7.2:1): captions, meta lines. The CI's on-dark-soft.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Passed, paid, online. As text on the surfaces.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Due soon, needs attention. As text on the surfaces.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, overdue, destructive actions. As text on the surfaces.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links. An alias of brand-strong.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px ring with a 2px surface gap.

fonts.usage: The wordmark cut (weight 800). Weights 400 to 700 load from Google Fonts.

families.display: "Bricolage Grotesque", "IBM Plex Sans Thai", "IBM Plex Sans", "Noto Sans SC", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif
families.sans: "Bricolage Grotesque", "IBM Plex Sans Thai", "IBM Plex Sans", "Noto Sans SC", "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", system-ui, sans-serif
families.text: "Bricolage Grotesque", "IBM Plex Sans Thai", "IBM Plex Sans", "Noto Sans SC", "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", system-ui, sans-serif
families.text-vi: "Bricolage Grotesque", "IBM Plex Sans", "IBM Plex Sans Thai", system-ui, sans-serif

groups.name: Display · Latin
groups.note: Bricolage Grotesque. Latin headings are Bold 700 (Google Fonts); the wordmark is ExtraBold 800, the 96pt static cut the website ships (fonts/). Latin only: Thai and Chinese fall through to IBM Plex Sans Thai and the CJK faces. Canva: font "Bricolage Grotesque"; the wordmark is Ultra Bold, letter spacing -30.

styles.name: hero
styles.sample: AI can build it. Who will run it?
styles.usage: One headline per page or poster. Fluid on the web: clamp(40px, 5.6vw, 92px).

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Section titles. Fluid on the web: clamp(24px, 2.1vw, 30px).

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The wordmark, Bricolage Grotesque 800, stretch normal, 30px on the web (Canva: Ultra Bold, letter spacing -30). Historical: the site nav now shows the outlined logo files too; use them everywhere. Clear space: at least the height of the B on every side.

styles.name: doc-mark
styles.usage: The wordmark in document headers: Audit Report, Weekly Update, Warranty.

groups.name: Display · Thai and Chinese
groups.note: IBM Plex Sans Thai Bold 700 (600 for smaller headings). Same sizes as the Latin display styles so a layout swaps language without reflowing. Looser leading for stacked Thai marks and CJK; tracking stays 0. Never condense or stretch the letters.

styles.name: hero-th
styles.sample: เอไอใครๆก็ทำได้ แต่ใครจะดูแล
styles.usage: Thai hero headline, IBM Plex Sans Thai Bold.

styles.name: hero-zh
styles.sample: AI 人人都会做，但谁来维护？
styles.usage: Simplified Chinese hero headline. Noto Sans SC Bold via the text stack.

styles.name: title-th
styles.sample: จากออดิต สู่การันตี

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Latin body is Bricolage Grotesque 400 to 600; Thai body is IBM Plex Sans Thai 400. The text stack puts Bricolage first and Bricolage has no Thai glyphs, so each script lands in its own face. Vietnamese uses text-vi: Bricolage covers Vietnamese, with IBM Plex Sans behind it.

styles.name: subhead
styles.sample: Big-project standards for work of any size

styles.usage: The paragraph under a hero headline. Max 32em.

styles.name: body

styles.usage: Running text on the web. Thai body text may go to 1.7.

styles.name: document
styles.sample: Over five business days we open up your system layer by layer.
styles.usage: Body text in reports and printed documents (11pt in print).

styles.name: small

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrows, Latin only. Thai and Chinese labels keep their case and 0 tracking.

groups.name: Data
groups.note: IBM Plex Mono, an addition for document IDs and code. The website has no mono face yet.

styles.name: id
styles.usage: Document and ticket IDs, versions, commit hashes.

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Inside pills and tight inline gaps.

tokens.name: space-s
tokens.usage: Gaps between pills, chips and stacked list rows.

tokens.name: space-m
tokens.usage: The minimum page margin and gap on phones.

tokens.name: space-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between columns and stacked blocks at desktop (site --gap: clamp(16px, 2vw, 28px)); also the hero copy gap.

tokens.name: space-margin
tokens.usage: Page side margin at desktop (site --m: clamp(16px, 2.4vw, 36px)).

tokens.name: space-l
tokens.usage: Document padding and gaps between groups inside a section.

tokens.name: space-section
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of a chapter at desktop (site: clamp(96px, 12vw, 180px)).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, tight inline gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside controls and between chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control padding, list-row gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile, form field gaps, page gutter minimum.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop, gaps between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gaps between page sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Hero and band padding.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything but buttons: cards, sheets, images, the app icon artwork. BoromTech corners are square; the seal is the brand's only curve.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, status pills and progress meters.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, checkboxes, code chips. 0: BoromTech corners are square (the CI's radius-none); the name stays so components keep working.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, menus. 0: square, as radius-sm.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, dialogs, image frames. 0: square, as radius-sm.

seal.note: The seal's geometry, in SVG user units. The stroke width is the system's unit s: clear space and the lockup gap are measured in it.

tokens.name: seal-box
tokens.usage: viewBox side of the standard seal (seal-*.svg) and of the website hero SVG.

tokens.name: seal-r
tokens.usage: Centre-line radius of the standard ring. Outer radius 475, inner 325.

tokens.name: seal-stroke
tokens.usage: Ring thickness = 1s. 37.5% of the radius; never change it.

tokens.name: seal-small-box
tokens.usage: viewBox side of the small-size seal and the favicon.

tokens.name: seal-small-r
tokens.usage: Centre-line radius of the small-size seal.

tokens.name: seal-small-stroke
tokens.usage: Small-size ring thickness, 47% of the radius: heavier so it holds at 16-32px.

tokens.name: seal-min-digital
tokens.usage: Smallest standard seal on screen. From 16 to 23px use the small-size seal.

tokens.name: seal-min-print
tokens.usage: Smallest seal in print. The lockup's minimum is the same height: 6mm tall (46mm wide), 24px tall on screen (183px wide).

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Entrances: things arriving on screen (the web equivalent of Canva's Rise).

tokens.name: ease-in-out
tokens.usage: Moving between states and between slides that share a layout.

tokens.name: duration-press
tokens.usage: Hover and press changes (120 to 160ms).

tokens.name: duration-slide
tokens.usage: Slide-to-slide transitions (Canva Match & Move, 0.5s).
